title: brightwheel Check-In Daily Check-Ins Leaderboard
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brightwheel:checkin checkin_count=*
| stats sum(checkin_count) as total_value, avg(checkin_count) as avg_value by classroom
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks classroom values by total and average daily check-ins across brightwheel check-in events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `checkin_count` values for each brightwheel check-in event and review total and average daily check-ins by classroom.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total daily check-ins.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which classroom shows the biggest daily check-ins numbers in your brightwheel check-in data.
